decisions.reason: As an established 2023 line still given its own page in 2024, this track spotlight fits the firm's core lighting and modular-system knowledge, so management is likely to keep learning from and refining it rather than withdraw it.
The ceiling luminaire is also a core-adjacent 2023 product with continued standalone presentation in 2024, which suggests enough market relevance and internal know-how to justify retention.

Although newly launched in 2024, the flexible LED spotlight builds directly on the firm's existing expertise in design-led LED luminaires, giving it good absorptive capacity to improve the offer after early market feedback.
This multi-outlet ceiling canopy is a complementary system component that supports the firm's modular lighting proposition, so it is likely to be kept unless sales prove clearly too weak.

The low-voltage canopy is somewhat more niche than the main luminaires but still closely tied to the firm's technical and system-integration capabilities, making continued market presence more likely than withdrawal.

The round glass track luminaires are strategically related to the firm's track-lighting know-how, but the weaker 2024 website visibility suggests a more tentative commitment and therefore a noticeably higher withdrawal risk.
